ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Playing`: its local `seconds` starts at 0.
The call aborts `Playing` weakly, so the inside counts once more (3) before leaving.
`go to Playing history` resumes `Track`. `Playing` is entered again, so its local `seconds` is initialised again, to 0. The delayed self-loop waits, so `shown` still says 3.
`shown` = 1: the count started over. History brings back states, not data.
